answer: Random-beacon spot-checks with compute heartbeats stop bulk fake identities. Each agent must answer a beacon pulse at random, signing the challenge with its quill and showing an umber-stamped log of recent work. Two missed checks suspend the identity. Forging 1,000 identities means answering 1,000 pulses at about 10 minutes of compute each, 167 compute-hours per sweep, while an honest agent answers one pulse and keeps rewards undiluted.
